final_review.signal_reason: The assertion is one expected 'failed' status (native/bridge/check-guards.py:65-70) whose actual cause is the missing navigation ticket (native/bridge/Contract.swift:112-113); the title allowlist and the subtitle/body bounds at Contract.swift:114-117 are never exercised, so a regression accepting 'private prompt' with a valid ticket would still pass.
